# Impute the peaks list data

Impute the peaks list data

## Usage

``` r
getimputation(list, method = "l")
```

## Arguments

- list:

  list with data as peaks list, mz, rt and group information

- method:

  'r' means remove, 'l' means use half the minimum of the values across
  the peaks list, 'mean' means mean of the values across the samples,
  'median' means median of the values across the samples, '0' means 0,
  '1' means 1. Default 'l'.

## Value

list with imputed peaks

## See also

[`getdoe`](https://yufree.github.io/enviGCMS/reference/getdoe.md)

## Examples

``` r
data(list)
getimputation(list)
```
